stem: A hose and harvest cart block part of the designated aisle before movement begins. What should Technician I do?
choices: Apply the supplied routine control to restore the path and verify it is clear before movement begins
Ignore it because harvest is scheduled
rationale: Apply the supplied routine control to restore the path and verify it is clear before movement begins. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
